Thank you, Heidelberg, for hosting us this week! 
 
For the past three days, we’ve been actively discussing the future of innovation in Europe with researchers, professors, industry representatives, and politicians. 
 
To secure its strategic autonomy, Europe must urgently close the innovation gap with the United States and China. We need to turn our knowledge into a true competitive advantage and position Europe as a global leader. 
 
Our future depends on it.
